Scratch / Public stats

See what’s happening.

Look up a Scratcher or find your next favorite project.

Enter a username to see public stats.

Data comes from Scratch’s public API and is cached for five minutes. Profile stats cover up to 40 public projects; larger accounts show a sample. Follower counts above this sample are shown as lower bounds. Project ranks apply to the loaded list. Global and country user rankings aren’t available here.
